history.summary: An integrated mixed-use 99-yr development directly above Bedok MRT and Bedok Mall, with a robust 109-txn URA series showing 4.26%/yr appreciation. history.rating_rationale: Best-in-batch combination of location and data: integrated mall + MRT (590m, effectively connected), 109 txns, 4.26%/yr appreciation, and a $1,611 PSF that is ~13% under the $1,858 median. A roomy 1,055 sqft 2BR at $1.7M sits in the liquid sweet spot with deep HDB-upgrader demand. Score_1000 of 652 and Elo 1346 confirm a strong profile; the sub-median PSF warrants a quick check on the specific stack/floor but the value gap is real.

history.summary: Integrated 99LH condo sitting directly above Bedok MRT and Bedok Mall — a large 1,055 sqft 2BR at $1,611 psf vs a 2BR project average of ~$1,834 psf (range $1,442-2,035). Genuinely below-market on deep, real transaction data, with the integrated-MRT/mall durability that holds value and rents fast.
history.rating_rationale: This is the standout of the five and the cheapness is REAL, not a quirk: web check shows Bedok Residences 2BR trailing-12m sales avg ~$1,834 psf with a tight $1,442-2,035 range, so $1,611.37 psf is clearly at the low end. That corroborates the algo's -5.9% age-adj and -18.9% psf-vs-cohort reads, and crucially these sit on DEEP data (appreciation_txns=109) — the most credible value signal in this batch per v3.4 (value leads, thin-comp skepticism not needed here). It's a CapitaLand integrated development directly atop Bedok MRT (EWL) with Bedok Mall downstairs — the strongest liquidity/rental profile of the group — in D16 (OCR, ~+4% forward region). 1,055 sqft for a 2BR is generously sized for the family-upgrader/rental market. Risks: 99LH (TOP 2015, ~88 yrs left — fine for a 5-7yr hold) and the large sqft means total $1.7m. Below-market entry + integrated-transit durability + strong forward region = Buy.
red_flags: 99-year leasehold (TOP 2015) — lease decay is a long-term drag, though minor over 5-7yr
$1.7m total on a 1,055 sqft 2BR — large unit lifts the absolute ticket
